h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Meghalaya

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Meghalaya

items.pText: A playground in Meghalaya has to survive some of the heaviest rain in the world. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches, parks, resorts and housing areas in Shillong, Tura, Jowai and the rest of the state. We plan for that rain from the first drawing.

We build everything at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, using galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts that do not rust. The equipment is sent by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it, self-standing or grouted. Shillong has many long-established schools with playing fields, and hill resorts around the state want a play area for visiting families. Tura, in the Garo Hills, is lower and warmer than Shillong. Share photos and the size of the site, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Designing for rain, moss and slopes

c: Wet ground and moss make paving slippery, so lay rubber flooring under the play equipment and keep a drain on the uphill side of the site. Slides with a closed tunnel stay drier inside, and roto-moulded decks shed water quickly. Shillong's cool, damp air means surfaces dry slowly, so a covered spot nearby, such as a gazebo from our garden decor range, gives children somewhere to wait out a shower. After the rains end, ask our after-sales team to look at any part that has worn or loosened.

items.q: Will playground equipment rust in Meghalaya's rain?
items.a: Our posts are galvanised and the slides, decks and panels are roto-moulded plastic, both weather-proof. Clear moss and leaves regularly and check fittings after the monsoon.

items.q: Can you plan a playground on a sloping school ground?
items.a: Yes. Send photos and a rough sketch of the slope. We often suggest one or two level terraces with compact equipment rather than one large structure.

items.q: Which slide type stays usable in wet weather?
items.a: Tunnel slides keep the sliding surface drier than open slides. Children should still wait until surfaces are dry after heavy rain before playing.
